description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator class, which aggregates multiple authentication failure reasons into a single exception, primarily used within an authentication failure handling context in the security package.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator
classes.description: Final class implementing AuthenticationFailureAggregator, utilizing singleton pattern, responsible for aggregating multiple authentication failure results into a single exception.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Aggregates a list of failed authentication results into a single DittoRuntimeException, handling multiple failure reasons and creating an aggregated message and headers.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeExceptionReasonsWithDescription
methods.description: Extracts and filters reasons of failure from authentication results, converting them into DittoRuntimeException instances that contain descriptions.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Recursively converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException if possible, unwrapping causes.

methods.name: buildAggregatedDescriptionFromDittoRuntimeExceptions
methods.description: Constructs an aggregated description string from multiple DittoRuntimeException reasons.

methods.name: buildAggregatedHeaders
methods.description: Builds combined DittoHeaders by aggregating headers from multiple DittoRuntimeException instances.
